AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: SHARED-FINDINGS section 2, copied verbatim in substance: the sim has no add-to-room phase -- creature creation IS construction -- so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (terror_eel.py:31-35). The game runs it from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom awaited by CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:393-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart. Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); the concrete trigger that would make it a gap is a relic, potion or power listening on modify_power_amount / on_power_applied / modify_block_* without gating on the player, or a starting power whose amount reads owner.max_hp. Rule 7: the four relic files and sts2_rl/powers.py that section 2's clause (a)/(b) argument cites are NOT hashed by this record. Here the effect is PowerCmd.Apply<ShriekPower>(Creature, ShriekAmount=70, Creature) (TerrorEel.cs:62-66) -> PowerCmd.apply(hooks, self, ShriekPower, 70). Self-applied, no card; the amount is the ascension-gated literal 70 (TerrorEel.cs:39, non-ascension branch) and not a fraction of max HP, so section 2 clause (b)'s HP-roll inversion cannot bite even though 70 happens to be half of 140.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: The REACHABLE graph is identical: CRASH <-> THRASH with initial CRASH, plus TERROR -> CRASH (TerrorEel.cs:68-84 vs terror_eel.py:37-56; executed, monster_probes_b04.py graphs). Two deliberate structural differences, both executed. (1) C# also registers a STUN_MOVE MoveState (TerrorEel.cs:73, 81) whose FollowUpState is TerrorState -- but NOTHING points at STUN_MOVE and it is not the initial state, so it is a dead registered node in the game too (the same shape as monster_state_machine G2's Inklet INIT_RAND; G2 is not re-verdicted here). The sim ports the reachable graph and omits it. (2) the sim sets must_perform_once_before_transitioning=True on TERROR_MOVE, which C# does not; C# gets the identical pin from the synthetic MoveState("STUNNED") that CreatureCmd.Stun installs (Creature.cs:537-542, MustPerformOnceBeforeTransitioning=true). Same observable, executed both ways -- see the guard below.

guards.what: Shriek -> TERROR: the sim splices the move machine by hand instead of installing a synthetic STUNNED move
guards.rationale: C#: ShriekPower.AfterDamageReceived (ShriekPower.cs:27-36) fires on `target == Owner && UnblockedDamage > 0 && CurrentHp <= Amount` and calls CreatureCmd.Stun(Owner, TerrorState.StateId) then removes itself; StunInternal (Creature.cs:524-544) builds MoveState("STUNNED", noop, StunIntent) with FollowUpStateId="TERROR_MOVE" and MustPerformOnce, hands it to SetMoveImmediate, so the stunned turn does nothing and the NEXT turn performs TERROR. Sim: ShriekPower.on_damage_received (powers.py:1937-1952) calls owner.trigger_terror(), which does machine.force_current_state(TERROR) + _current_move = TERROR + CreatureCmd.stun(hooks, self) (terror_eel.py:58-65) with NO next_move_key. Executed (monster_probes_b04.py eel-stun): after trigger_terror the eel is stunned with current=TERROR_MOVE and can_transition_away=False; the next three enemy sides telegraph ['TERROR_MOVE', 'CRASH_MOVE', 'THRASH_MOVE'], i.e. one dead turn, then TERROR, then back to the CRASH/THRASH ring -- the same two-turn shape as the game. The mid-move trigger (Thorns during the eel's own attack, so the eel's end-of-turn roll runs immediately after) was executed separately and still lands on TERROR_MOVE, because must_perform_once pins it exactly as the C# STUNNED state's own flag does. The one residual difference is the StateLog, which the game grows by one entry here and the sim does not -- that is monster_state_machine G4, whose own text already names TerrorEel and shows it CANNOT exhibit the observable (the eel has no RandomBranchState, so no weight reads the log). Not re-verdicted.

Non-ascension, TerrorEel.cs:39-45: ShriekAmount 70, CrashDamage 16, ThrashDamage 3, ThrashRepeat 3; VigorPower 6 (:102), VulnerablePower 99 (:117). Sim terror_eel.py:13-18 = 16 / 3 / 3 / 6 / 70 / 99. All match. THRASH awaits the 3-hit attack BEFORE granting the +6 Vigor on both sides, so the Vigor lands on the next CRASH.
